Medical professionals face very different challenges depending on their expertise. Materialise can support you, from the routine to the complex, with personalized solutions based on 3D printing and planning. Whether you are a surgeon, radiologist, cardiologist, podiatrist, or physical therapist, we can help you forward.

Personalized engineering and simulation are increasingly seen as core competencies for biomedical research teams. Providing professors and students with an R&D software toolbox prepares them for the reality of careers in research or the medical industry.
A clinically accepted gait analysis system built to support biomedical research teams with personalized engineering and simulation.
Discover how industries — like healthcare, aerospace, and more — are evolving with 3D printing thanks to insights from our customers and experts.
Across healthcare, medtech, aerospace, and beyond, we bring technologies, partners, and capabilities together to personalize care for more patients and advance industrial production at scale.

From humble beginnings in 1990, when founder and Chairman of the Board Fried Vancraen bought his first 3D printer, Materialise has become an industry standard. As our journey continues to unfold, our commitment to helping our customers break new ground is stronger than ever.

Why build if it’s not built to last? We ensure quality in everything we do. As customer needs and technologies evolve, we improve to remain relevant over time. Discover more about why customers worldwide trust in the quality of our services and solutions.

Why are we ahead of all the rest? We invest in people because they are the cornerstone of our success. Inspired by our mission and curious by nature, they go the extra mile, both for our customers and society.

There is no greater inspiration or motivation than seeing what people do with our solutions and services. Across industries, our customers leverage our knowledge and expertise to drive innovation and make a difference in their fields.

We’re always asking, “What can we do to make 3D printing more sustainable?” By reducing the environmental impact of our operations, innovating continuously to advance 3D printing in a sustainable way, and empowering our customers to embed sustainability into their business models, we aim to drive positive outcomes for the environment, business, and society as a whole.
Committed to improving our operations and empowering our customers, we strive to innovate and reduce waste, manage our environmental impact, and achieve net zero carbon emissions.
Being transparent about the overall impact of 3D printing helps us and our customers firmly embed sustainability into everything we do.

How can I cancel my order?

You can cancel a recently placed order by directly replying to your order confirmation email. If printing has not yet started, our Customer Service team can cancel your order. Please note that our automated systems process orders quickly, so the time window before printing has started and when we can still accept cancellations is very short.
How can I check the status of my order?
You can track the progress of your order in the ‘Orders’ section of your profile after logging in to OnSite. If your order status reads 'In production,' you will also see the estimated shipment date.
When your order is shipped, you will also see the UPS tracking number on this page and receive it via email. You can use this tracking number to monitor your package's status in transit.

Transit time depends on your order, though it is usually 1 – 5 days after shipping. Please note that we cannot guarantee how quickly the courier or customs will process your package. You can track your order using your UPS tracking number.
There are no duties or import taxes for orders sent to EU countries or the UK.
Can I combine multiple orders into one shipment?

しかし、プロセスの堅牢性と再現性が不十分であること、また、製造後の検査の必要性と品質保証面において、従来の製造方法と比較してコスト高となる可能性があることが、量産への幅広い採用を妨げることに繋がっています
これにより、金属AMの生産性が向上し、スクラップ率が減少するためメーカーがオペレーションを進め、金属AMを量産のために導入する道が開かれます

両社は、量産において金属AMの利用拡大に関心を持つあらゆる業界のパートナーを募集しています
